major_reagents.name: transposition buffer (Tris-acetate, K-acetate, Mg-acetate, DMF, NP-40)

transitions.operation_detail: In-house Tn5 loaded with Read1 (s5-ME) and 5'-phosphorylated Read2 (s7-ME) transferred strands annealed to the blocked ME-complement; transposition of fixed, permeabilized cells at 37 C for 30 minutes, followed by washing in nuclei isolation buffer. Fragments carrying two s7 ends cannot be amplified by the final primer pair and fragments carrying two s5 ends cannot acquire a barcode, so only s5/s7 fragments proceed; these by-products are not modelled as separate states.

In situ reverse transcription inside the transposed cells using the biotinylated, 5'-phosphorylated RT primer (s7-ME-UMI-biotin dT-poly(dT)VN); Maxima H Minus adds untemplated cytosines at the cDNA 3' end. Washes and buffer exchange into hybridization mix are folded into this transition.

major_reagents.name: T4 ligation buffer, RNase inhibitor, Triton X-100

transitions.operation_detail: Cells are split into a 96-well round-1 plate; the round-1 barcode strand pre-annealed to the round-1 linker hybridizes to the universal 5' overhang of both the transposed DNA and the cDNA and is ligated to their 5' phosphate. Round-1 blocking strand is then added to quench unbound barcodes, and all wells are pooled.

Pooled cells are split into the 96-well round-2 plate; the round-2 barcode/linker adapter hybridizes to the round-1 5' overhang and is ligated, then the round-2 blocking strand is added and wells are pooled again.

Pooled cells are split into the 96-well round-3 plate; the round-3 barcode carries the Illumina P7 adapter, so this ligation both adds the third cell barcode and installs P7. Round-3 blocking, final pooling, washing and aliquoting are folded into this transition.
Reverse crosslinking releases both barcoded molecular streams, after which streptavidin beads capture the biotinylated cDNA while barcoded transposed DNA remains in the supernatant.

major_reagents.name: MyOne C1 streptavidin Dynabeads
major_reagents.role: affinity separation of the cDNA branch

transitions.operation_detail: After reverse crosslinking (proteinase K, SDS, PMSF quench) and streptavidin capture of the biotinylated cDNA, the supernatant containing barcoded transposed DNA is purified and amplified with the library-specific v2_Ad1 (P5/i5) primer and the P7 primer: 72 C 5 min gap fill, 98 C 30 s, then 5 plus qPCR-determined cycles. Purification and quantification are folded in.

Bead-bound barcoded cDNA is incubated with the LNA-containing TSO and Maxima H Minus RT (30 min room temperature, then 90 min at 42 C). The TSO anneals to the untemplated 3' cytosines and is copied, appending the TSO handle complement to the cDNA 3' end; the TSO itself is not carried forward. Bead washes are folded in.

Whole-transcriptome amplification with the RNA PCR (ISPCR/TSO handle) primer and the P7 primer in Kapa HiFi: 95 C 3 min, then 5 plus qPCR-determined cycles. AMPure purification and Qubit quantification are folded in.

50 ng of amplified cDNA is fragmented at 55 C for 5 minutes with a Tn5 homodimer loaded with the Read1 (s5-ME) strand annealed to the blocked ME-complement. The left-hand (TSO-proximal) and internal fragments lack the P7/barcode end and are not amplifiable; only the 3'-proximal fragment carrying the UMI, barcodes and P7 proceeds. Column purification is folded in.

Final RNA library amplification with the sample-indexed v2_Ad1 (P5/i5) primer and the P7 primer: 72 C 5 min gap fill, 98 C 30 s, then 7 cycles. AMPure purification and KAPA quantification are folded in.
